svg.title: Control ownership
svg.desc: One power stage. Five operating modes. Explicit control responsibility. Generic, illustrative example. Not an OEM-approved architecture or a statement of compliance. Control responsibility does not mean every listed quantity is an independent simultaneous setpoint. Unspecified loop roles remain unspecified. Hardware bidirectionality is distinct from the power-flow direction enabled in each operating mode.
